stem.text: An object is projected horizontally. The object falls a vertical distance $y$ and travels a horizontal distance $x$ before landing on the ground.

stem.alt: Diagram of a horizontal projection from an upper horizontal line down to a lower horizontal line, labelled direction of projection, vertical distance, horizontal distance and landing point.

stem.text: A second object is projected horizontally with the same initial velocity and falls a vertical distance $4y$ before landing on the ground.
Assume that air resistance is negligible.
Which horizontal distance does the second object travel?
